# temps_service_link (Resource)

Links a managed service to a project so its deployments receive the service's connection variables (for PostgreSQL: `POSTGRES_URL`, `POSTGRES_HOST`, ...). Every change replaces the link.

Import with `<service_id>/<project_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `external_services:read`, `external_services:write`, `projects:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deployments of the project receive the connection variables of the service.
resource "temps_service_link" "web_db" {
  service_id = temps_service.db.id
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `service_id` (Number) ID of the service.

### Optional

- `custom_database_name` (String) Database name when `database_provisioning_mode` is `custom`.
- `database_provisioning_mode` (String) Which logical database deployments receive: `project` (one per project, the default), `project_environment` (one per environment) or `custom` (`custom_database_name`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric link ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <service_id>/<project_id>
terraform import temps_service_link.web_db 7/12
```
